control_profile: weekly turnover, downward volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, close-confirmed loss stop and one-way turnover cap
falsifier: The exact high-risk-minus-low-risk inversion matches or exceeds the parent after doubled costs, which would invalidate the claimed direction of the low-risk spread.
formation_horizon: one hundred twenty-six completed bars of market-residual risk history
hypothesis: As a diagnostic control, exactly reversing every parent target should destroy the low-risk premium if the original long-low-risk and short-fragile direction is genuine.
rebalance_horizon: weekly at the first daily boundary of the week
